offline.title: You're offline
offline.works: You can still see today's tasks, habits and schedule as of your last visit, tick off tasks, check in habits and quick-add tasks. These are saved on this device and sent when you're back online.
offline.needsConnection: Everything else — journal, goals, insights, planning, editing — needs a connection. Pages you haven't opened recently may not load.
offline.queued: Saved on this device — it will sync when you're back online.
offline.update: A new version of Life OS is ready.
